Lily hopes to visit London one day. Lily and Ben had great fun there. Lily thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. For example, it is foolish to prophesy about next year's markets.

Lily is going to travel to London in October. Last Thursday, Lily and Ben went to the family dinner table. Ben is interested in drawing. What's more, the old bridge is unsafe, so walkers must use the tunnel.
Lily's favorite animal is the panda. The weather was cloudy that day. Lily wrote about the day in the diary. In fact, the noodles are served with black bean sauce.
Lily learned a lot about English. Lily wants to be a engineer in the future. Both of them like rice and coffee.
